ZOM-363.title: Achievements are claimable twice even though they shouldn't
ZOM-363.desc:
Achievements are claimable twice back to back. 

So if I completed 3/3 after claiming it, I can also claim 3/5 as well. Then it goes to 3/10.

[ScreenRecording_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6285]_1.MOV]([URL_52656])

It should not be claimable if it's not claimable.

ZOM-314.title: Adding new buttons to settings Panel
ZOM-314.desc:
We want to add three new buttons to the Main Menu Settings Panel only. All these buttons will function the same way as in DD:

1. Notification On/Off
   Allows players to enable or disable notification settings.
2. Contact Us
   Directs players to Helpshift. This button will be used when [PERSON_NAME_0029] implements Helpshift.
3. Copy ID
   Displays the player’s user ID. When the player taps this area, the ID is [IDENTIFIER_19005] copied to the clipboard.

ZOM-553.title: Make changes to boss arena refill and nuke spawn behavior
ZOM-553.desc:
'@[PERSON_NAME_0054] said:

> @[PERSON_NAME_0120] I'd like to make the following changes to boss arena:
>
> 1. When you clear the board, it triggers a manual refill, despite timer not hitting 30 seconds.
> 2. The nuke still spawns, but on top of the refill so it's the first thing you click.
> 3. The refill will follow the same refill rules as if the timer refill was triggered.
> 4. The timer refill still triggers, and the same rules. This won't cause an issue because even if the refill just happened 3 seconds prior, the refill algo only refill what's missing, so likely it will just refill 1-2 item sets.
